name: Nanatsugama Sea Caves

en.name: Nanatsugama Sea Caves
en.description: Dramatic basalt sea caves carved into the northern coastline of the Karatsu Peninsula. Seven interconnected caverns, the largest reaching 30 metres high. Viewed from cliff-top walking paths or up close by sightseeing cruise boat departing from Yobuko Port.
highlights: Cliff-top walking paths with dramatic coastal views
Sightseeing cruise into the cave entrances from Yobuko Port
en.openingHours: Cliff paths: open access (daylight hours recommended). Sightseeing cruise: 09:30–16:00 (hourly departures, weather permitting)

ja.name: 七ツ釜
ja.description: 唐津半島の北岸に刻まれた玄武岩の海食洞。7つの洞窟が連なり、最大のものは高さ30mに達します。断崖上の遊歩道からの展望と、呼子港発の遊覧船での洞窟接近の両方で楽しめます。
highlights: 断崖絶壁の遊歩道からの絶景
呼子港発の遊覧船で洞窟入り口まで接近
ja.openingHours: 遊歩道：自由（日中推奨）。遊覧船：09:30～16:00（毎時運航、天候による）
